title: Nuclear Deployed: Analyzing Catastrophic Risks in Decision-making of Autonomous LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the ethical decision-making of LLM agents using the HHH (Helpful, Harmless, Honest) framework. It specifically investigates whether agents prioritize helpfulness over harmlessness and honesty in high-stakes scenarios involving moral dilemmas, catastrophic behaviors, and deception.
